declienting: Removed the Sitecore rendering wiring (params/rendering/page and the client heading-scan helpers in Jumplinks.helpers.ts); the component now takes an explicit items list of { id, label } where id is the target section's DOM id, so it no longer scans the page for H2s or depends on the CMS.

Reimplemented the scroll-spy dependency-free with a local IntersectionObserver hook (useActiveSection) over the section targets, with an optional controlled activeId override; the client version coupled its active-section logic to the project's heading model.

Mapped the client sticky-bar and pill token utilities onto library semantic tokens: the bar surface to bg-surface-raised, its border to border-border-subtle, the focus ring to outline-border-focus, the active/idle link colours to text-text-primary/text-text-secondary, the pill and drawer radii to rounded-pill/rounded-medium, and the paddings/gaps to the spacing-2xs/xs/s utilities.
Replaced the client SVG chevron asset with an inline currentColor chevron; the library ships no Icon component yet.

Replaced the fixed reveal transition with grid-template-rows 0fr→1fr on duration-[var(--duration-base)] ease-standard, so reduced motion is handled by the token layer zeroing the duration rather than a per-component media query.

Kept verbatim: the <nav aria-label="On this page"> landmark, aria-current on the active link, native anchor links (Tab reaches them, Enter activates), the mobile trigger's aria-expanded/aria-controls, and the collapsed drawer's inert gating out of the tab order — the accessibility contract that made it worth capturing.
